passes.name: Profile is a permanent page, with details/editor outside modal
Project save preserves each member tool assignment without cross-product expansion
50 presets / 500 skills / 20 projects are searchable and paginated
Preset detail return restores search, page and scroll; member drill-down returns to preset
Concrete project cards and bulk actions do not masquerade as global destructive controls
Two different Skills keep independent restore records and restore preserves later targets
Restoration refuses subsequent content edits rather than silently overwriting them
Multi-project application isolates result/retry and does not expand saved member tool mappings
All application history beyond 20 records and deleted-preset snapshots remain reachable
Project-specific removal changes only chosen shared project targets
Discarding a dirty project-derived preset returns to the actual originating project view
Tool-mode and global/project changes preserve exact saved mapping unless explicitly overridden
Disabled and deleted preset members remain visible and cannot be silently installed
Stale application preview requires a fresh confirmation before writing
Overlapping presets preserve later-used shared targets when the first application is undone
Old application undo cannot remove a target that was deleted and recreated later
Saving an existing preset retains the original list return context
Cancelling record undo preserves return from record detail to its history list
Confirming record undo preserves return from record detail to its history list
A copied preset returns through its source detail to the originating filtered list
